## Invitations

During the quarter, the outreach programme issued 1991 invitations across North City. A total of 1431 people attended, representing an attendance rate of 71.9 per cent. The figures provide a straightforward summary of participation following the invitation activity and support continued monitoring of engagement.

The attendance result will inform routine review of how invitations are delivered and how invitees are supported to attend. The service will continue to maintain clear records of invitations and attendance so that follow-up activity can be directed appropriately.

## Contact

SMS contact was used for 1687 invitees. Reminder messages were also sent to 1687, providing an additional prompt for people who had received an invitation. Using these channels supports consistent communication and helps keep the appointment information visible to invitees.

Staff continue to contact people who did not attend, with follow-up focused on maintaining engagement and supporting future attendance. The outreach activity was prepared by G. Evans.
